units.source_text: 此时天色未明，残月当空，夜雾弥漫，气象幽奇。

en.t: At this hour the sky had not yet grown light; a waning moon hung overhead, night mist spread everywhere, and the scene had a strange, mysterious air.

units.source_text: 源氏大将服装简陋，举止畏缩，却也另有一种风韵。

en.t: General Genji was plainly dressed and moved with a timid reserve, yet this too gave him a distinctive grace.

units.source_text: 可巧承香殿女御的哥哥头中将从藤壶院出来，站在月光照不到的屏障背后。

en.t: By chance, the Captain, elder brother of the Consort of the Shokoden, came out from the Fujitsubo residence and stood behind a screen where the moonlight did not reach.

units.source_text: 源氏大将不曾注意他，却被他看见了，真是遗憾！

en.t: General Genji did not notice him, but the man saw Genji; what a regrettable thing it was.

units.source_text: 这头中将定将毁谤他了。

en.t: That Captain would surely speak ill of him.
